fusions.name: Dunking Hold
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and holds it under, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. It is left [Soaked] and 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Quake
fusions.desc: Brings both fists down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Silverback Girth
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute's Reckoning
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.
